name: fivem-mcp
description: Let an agent build and test FiveM resources against a local FXServer and running game: RCON, server/client Lua eval, server console + client log, NUI DevTools, game screenshots and an entity inspector. Dev servers only.

rcon_password.title: RCON password
rcon_password.description: Must match `set rcon_password` in your server.cfg.

bridge_token.title: ai_dev_bridge token
bridge_token.description: Must match `set ai_bridge_token` in your server.cfg (any long random string).

fxserver_host.title: FXServer host
fxserver_host.description: The bridge only accepts localhost, so keep 127.0.0.1 unless you know why not.

fxserver_port.title: FXServer port
fxserver_port.description: endpoint_add_tcp/udp port of the server (RCON uses the same port).

cef_port.title: FiveM CEF DevTools port
cef_port.description: The game client's NUI DevTools port.

images.title: Return images
images.description: Turn off if your model or MCP host cannot take image input; tools then return text/JSON only.
